biggest_catch: $350 requires $7,500+ in qualifying ACH direct deposits within the first 90 days; the Gold Account must stay open at least 90 days; new account holders only. The 'up to $1,200' headline is stale - current official terms only support the $350 direct-deposit tier (aggregators report the money-market and investment tiers were removed).
catches: New Gold Account holders only; no Nevada State Bank deposit account in the past 12 months.
$7,500+ in qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days (payroll, salary, pension, Social Security via ACH; excludes P2P/Zelle/Venmo/PayPal, RTP, internal transfers).
Gold Account must be open for a minimum of 90 days and open at bonus payout.
Bonus paid into the Gold Account within 60 days of meeting qualifications.

Limited-time offer, subject to change without notice.

payout_quote: $350 Direct Deposit Bonus: The Gold Account must receive qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days totaling $7,500 or more. Qualifying direct deposits include regular, periodic Automated Clearing House (ACH) credits, such as payroll, salary, pension, or government benefits (e.g., Social Security). Deposits that do not qualify are those made through Real-Time Payments (RTP) or peer-to-peer services such as PayPal, Zelle, and Venmo.
payout_value_note: Flat $350 direct-deposit tier. Larger aggregator-reported combination tiers are not verified here.

steps: Open a new Nevada State Bank Gold Account with a $50 minimum opening deposit (online-only offer; new-to-bank customers only).
Within the first 90 days, receive qualifying ACH direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security; no P2P/internal transfers) totaling $7,500 or more.
Keep the Gold Account open at least 90 days; the $350 bonus deposits within 60 days of meeting the qualifications.
